name: Tokyo Day
detailed_description:
🏮 Tokyo Day

A romance-mystery visual novel where every choice shapes love, memory, and fate.

🔹 ABOUT THIS GAME

You wake up on a quiet street near Tokyo with no name and no memories.

A girl named Aiko offers her help — kind, gentle… and not entirely honest.

As you recover your past through memory puzzles and dialogue, the town begins to distort around you.

Is this a dream? A trap? Or something you've lived before?

Tokyo Day blends romance, mystery, and psychological suspense in a richly immersive visual novel. Uncover lost memories, shape your bond with Aiko through branching choices, and explore a story that shifts based on your decisions.

Your relationship score affects the outcome — leading to multiple possible endings, from touching romance to unsettling revelations.

🌸 FEATURES

🧠 Memory Match Puzzles

Solve short, immersive memory puzzles to unlock each chapter and recover lost fragments of your identity.

💬 Choice-Driven Dialogue

Your responses shape the bond between you and Aiko — and decide the ending you reach. Relationship scores affect outcomes, tone, and fate.

🎭 Mystery Meets Romance

A touching love story wrapped in layers of mysticism, loss, and reality distortion. Can you trust your memories... or her?

🖼 Unlockable Art & 18+ Content

Every chapter rewards you with new illustrations — some sweet, some intimate, and some... unsettling.

🌐 Fully Localized UI and Dialogue

Supports multiple languages with dynamic font and text rendering.

“Some people you meet only once. Others, again and again… until you remember.”

short_description: You wake up in a quiet town with no memories. A girl named Aiko helps you remember — but the more you recover, the less real things become. A romance-mystery visual novel with puzzles, choices, and 6 possible endings.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Japanese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 / AMD Radeon R5 240
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Use a 16:9 display for best experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • Additional Notes: Use a 16:9 display for best experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features mature content not suitable for all ages or for viewing at work. Adult themes include sexual behavior, general mature situations, and light horror elements (unsettling imagery).
All characters depicted in sexual content are 21 years of age or older.
